_comment: Third-party hardware benchmarks and published pool fees for the synthetic-miner selector on panel 4. These are citable figures, not assumptions: each row carries the source it came from. The only number the dashboard does not know is the operator's power price, which is a blank input. Add rows as better benchmarks appear; keep the source field honest.

gpus.label: NVIDIA H100 SXM
gpus.source: per-card figure published by AlphaPool (pearl.alphapool.tech); 700W is NVIDIA's SXM TDP

gpus.label: NVIDIA RTX 3090
gpus.source: 75 TH/s, quoted May 2026 before the June and August forks changed the hashrate scale; treat as indicative only

pools.label: PearlHash
pools.source: pearlhash.xyz states 1% pool fee, 0% miner fee

pools.label: Official datacenter pool (H100/H200)
pools.source: 20% fee for datacenter cards, reported by AlphaMine and Hashrate Index
